weekTheme: Why an Agency in an AI Age
hook: 'Can't ChatGPT just do our marketing?' Fair question. Here's our honest answer.
direction: AI drafts; it doesn't know your congregation, own your results, or notice the ad account quietly burning money on a Saturday night. Tools need operators. We use AI heavily ourselves — openly — which is exactly why we know where it stops.

facebook.text:
'Can't ChatGPT just do our marketing?' Fair question. Here's our honest answer.

Yes, we use AI. Heavily. Openly. It drafts fast, it iterates, it saves hours.

But AI doesn't know your congregation. It doesn't own your results. And it won't notice your ad account quietly burning money on a Saturday night.

Tools need operators. Someone still has to set the strategy, read the numbers, catch the problems, and make judgment calls. That's the work. AI just changes what the work looks like — it doesn't replace the person doing it.
